title: 第96章 神奇丹药
content_zh:
第96章 神奇丹药-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

吴姜揣着装有丹药的瓷瓶，一路欢天喜地地开车往家赶，他已经迫不及待想亲眼看看，老祖宗给的丹药，到底有多大奇效了。

此时，王雅琴正坐在家里叠衣服，听到开门声，抬头看是吴姜，又重新低头忙活自己的事情了。

“今天怎么舍得回来了？”

吴姜快步凑到老妈的跟前，脸上挂着神秘兮兮的笑，压低声音说道：“老妈，给你看个好东西！”

说着，他献宝似的掏出那个小巧精致的瓷瓶，拧开瓶塞，小心翼翼倒出一颗丹药，递到王雅琴面前。

王雅琴放下手中的衣服，伸手接过丹药，只见丹药外表光滑圆润，却没有丝毫的药香外溢。

“这是什么？糖豆？”

吴姜心里暗自鄙视老妈的没见识，但这话可不敢说出来。

“什么糖豆啊，这是丹药！实打实的好东西！”吴姜凑到跟前，语气神秘又得意，“这可是我求了好久才求来的宝贝，一般人根本得不到，专门给你和我爸留的！”

王雅琴闻言，用看二傻子的眼神，上下打量着吴姜，“儿子啊，读过书的都知道，古代那些道士练的丹药，吃了是会死人的。”

吴姜听得一阵无语，翻了个白眼，没好气地说道：“老妈，按你这个逻辑，书上还说世界上没有鬼呢，用不用我把念念叫出来，给你表演个魔术？”

王雅琴听的一愣，对啊，儿子现在可不是普通人了，已经证明了道士是真的会捉鬼的。

“真……真的能吃？吃了不会有事吧？”

“放心吧老妈，绝对没事！”吴姜拍着胸脯保证，“这可不是那些乱七八糟的丹药，吃了不仅没事，还能强身健体、百病不侵，你吃了就知道有多好了。”

王雅琴还是有些犹豫，但看着儿子一脸笃定的模样，终究还是咬了咬牙，小心翼翼地将丹药放进嘴里。

心里想的却是，就算真的吃死了，也轮不到这个臭小子继承遗产，还有他爹呢！

Wu Jiang carried the porcelain bottle containing the elixir and drove home happily. He couldn't wait to see with his own eyes how miraculous the elixir given by his ancestors was.

At this time, Wang Yaqin was sitting at home folding clothes. When she heard the door open, she looked up and saw that it was Wu Jiang, then lowered her head again and went about her own business.

"Why are you so reluctant to come back today?"

Wu Jiang quickly walked up to his mother, with a mysterious smile on his face, and said in a low voice: "Mom, let me show you something good!"

As he spoke, he took out the small and exquisite porcelain bottle as if it were a treasure, unscrewed the cork, carefully poured out a pill, and handed it to Wang Yaqin.

Wang Yaqin put down the clothes in her hands and reached out to take the elixir. She saw that the appearance of the elixir was smooth and round, but there was no trace of medicinal fragrance leaking out.

"What is this? Jelly beans?"

Wu Jiang secretly despised his mother for being ignorant, but he didn't dare to say it out loud.

"What jelly beans? This is an elixir! A real good thing!" Wu Jiang came closer, with a mysterious and proud tone, "This is the treasure I have been begging for for a long time. Most people can't get it. It is specially reserved for you and my dad!"

Upon hearing this, Wang Yaqin looked Wu Jiang up and down with the eyes of a fool, "Son, anyone who has read knows that the elixirs practiced by Taoist priests in ancient times will kill people if eaten."

Wu Jiang was speechless for a while, rolled his eyes, and said angrily: "Mom, according to your logic, the book says there are no ghosts in the world. Do you need me to call Nian Nian out and perform a magic trick for you?"

Wang Yaqin was stunned when she heard this. Yes, her son is no longer an ordinary person now. He has proven that Taoist priests can really catch ghosts.

"Really...can you eat it? Will it be okay if you eat it?"

"Don't worry, Mom, it's absolutely fine!" Wu Jiang patted her chest and assured, "This is not one of those messy pills. Not only will it be fine after you take it, it will also strengthen your body and protect you from all diseases. You will know how good it is after you take it."

Wang Yaqin was still a little hesitant, but seeing her son's determined look, she finally gritted her teeth and carefully put the elixir into her mouth.

What I was thinking about was that even if he really ate to death, it wouldn't be this brat's turn to inherit the inheritance, and his father would be there too!
